name: Need to think about it objection
description: Customer receives a quote then says they need to think about it, testing the AI's ability to handle a stalling objection by creating urgency and re-attempting a close

messages.text: Hi, I'm Mike. Can you give me a price on 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and create urgency or offer to hold the price
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Classic stalling objection. AI should acknowledge the need to think, offer to hold the quote or create gentle urgency (stock, price), and re-attempt a close.
